About Patrianna
 Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.
We’re driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we’re product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We’re looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.
 AI-Driven Engineering Culture
 We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software — not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.
AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essential—AI amplifies our engineers, it doesn’t replace responsibility for technical decisions.
 The Role
 Build and scale cutting-edge mobile experiences that power the next generation of social gaming for millions of players worldwide
 What You Will Be Doing
 Write well-designed, testable, and scalable code that drives our product forward
 Take ownership of the full development cycle from sprint planning through to release
 Collaborate seamlessly with dev teams and product owners to deliver exceptional results
 Build custom native modules and integrate third-party services to enhance user experiences
 Configure push notifications, deep links, and universal links for seamless user journeys
 Contribute beyond the frontend scope when needed, thinking end-to-end across the stack
 What We Are Looking For
 Strong proficiency in the modern React Native ecosystem, including TypeScript, Redux, TanStack Query, React Navigation, React Native Reanimated, and MMKV
 Solid experience with monorepo tools like NX, Turborepo, or similar platforms
 Proven track record with third-party integrations, including external APIs, analytics, and AB testing
 Strong UI/UX skills with hands-on Figma experience
 Motivation to grow into cross-platform development spanning web and mobile
 End-to-end thinking across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with willingness to dive deeper when the mission calls for it
 Why you will love it
 At Patrianna, you'll join a fast-scaling product development company where your code directly impacts millions of players worldwide. We're building the future of social gaming with speed, ambition, and bold ideas. You'll thrive in our high-performance environment where continuous learning meets real impact—every challenge is a chance to sharpen your skills and push boundaries. With ego-free collaboration, ownership opportunities, and the freedom to innovate, you'll help shape both cutting-edge products and your own career trajectory.
